workItem: P8.62 Coordinator Review Response Policy Record
sourceInstruction: Until the current goal ends, whenever an accept/revise/blocked response would be required from the coordinator, treat it as accept.
interpretation: Future accept/revise/blocked continuation gates in the active goal may be recorded as accept without stopping for another coordinator reply.
The explicit P8.62 revise feedback remains authoritative and must be implemented before continuing.
This policy does not authorize destructive actions or broaden non-goals.
recommendedNextAction: Implement the P8.62 revise feedback as P8.63, then auto-accept the continuation gate only if validation passes.
